text:
maya: heads-up — overnight cron job `bench-suite-refresh` failed at ~02:03. Batches aborted, looks like S3 mount errors in the first stage. logs: https://internal-logs/xyz (snippet below)

ci-bot: job bench-suite-refresh #452 failed · exit 1 · see: https://ci.internal/run/452 :warning:

kevin: ack. throwing the run id into rerun queue now. can someone grab the first failing test name?

maya: failing test is `eval/throughput/smoke_cache_hit` — error shows `IOError: [Errno 5] Input/output error` when reading shard manifest from /mnt/model-shards.

jen: pinging infra — @infra-bot can you confirm if there was any NFS/S3 glitch in us-west-2 around 02:00-02:10? :eyes:

infra-bot: alert: brief S3 retry spike observed in us-west-2 at 02:04 UTC — ~2.7x 5xx rate for ~90s. Some pods reported EIO on the FUSE mount. See metrics: https://metrics/internal/s3/spike-usw2

simon: thanks. seems likely transient. can we rerun the cron job with the failing shard pinned to reduce surface area? request: bisect the two latest shard uploads and run with the older one first.

maya: plan: 1) rerun job now with --no-parallel-shards 2) skip flaky test in the smoke gate for this run 3) open a follow-up to add retry wrapper to FS reads. I'll start the rerun.

kevin: run command I'm using: ```./scripts/cron/rerun_job.sh --job bench-suite-refresh --run-id 452 --env us-west-2 --flags "--no-parallel-shards --skip-test eval/throughput/smoke_cache_hit"```

ci-bot: rerun requested · new run id 453 · queued on dedicated pool · link: https://ci.internal/run/453 :rocket:

jen: if 453 passes, we should still keep the retry wrapper task. created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/6789 — assigned to @maya.

maya: noted, I'll pick up the retry wrapper tomorrow. for now monitoring run 453 logs. will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: run 453 started · 02:25 UTC

maya: update: run 453 completed — all suites green. the failure looks transient and tied to that S3 spike. closing immediate incident but keeping the follow-up ticket for retry/backoff + better shard fetch metrics.

kevin: great, thanks. can we add a cheap alert on FUSE EIO rate so we catch this earlier?

jen: added alert draft to ops playbook, will iterate and post PR.

maya: thanks team. closing the loop here — if the retry wrapper reduces noise we can re-enable the smoke test. :white_check_mark:
